scope: Sixteen assigned research collections. Each actual dataset descriptor was fetched; scientific source or schema inspection depth is explicit per original. Catalogue-only private/relationship tables and duplicate containers are not claimed as fully inspected. No individual participant, director, contact or applicant rows are published.
statusMeaning: Connected means at least one bounded view is connected; it does not imply every table in that collection is published. Supporting means source family evidence supports an existing derived view. Candidate entries retain specific adapter/identity gaps.

reviews.summary: Cumulative CIHR British Columbia institution summary supports the existing annual CIHR view, but lacks its fiscal grain.
reviews.mapConnection: Exact institution names can use the reviewed institutional registry; bc_region_code is an analysis macroregion and has no automatic HA/LHA equivalence.
needs: Recover decision/payment window and CIHR contribution/equipment definitions before a separate cumulative view; reconcile to C041.
cannot: Cannot label cumulative contributions as annual payments or allocate institution totals to populations.

reviews.summary: CAUBO long finance source adds 14 sponsored research expenditure observations; its 14 income observations duplicate two periods already released. Research Infosource intensity and CRA compact extracts remain candidates.
reviews.mapConnection: Exact CAUBO institution codes join seven reviewed comparator campuses for contextual points.
needs: Research Infosource faculty intensity needs publisher denominator/method reconciliation: Dalhousie current income differs by $121,000 from CAUBO. CRA compact numeric-code fields include Y/N flags and need a raw dictionary/column alignment review.
cannot: Income and expenditures are different measures; no NHHR economic benefit or campus allocation. CRA charity finances are not automatically institutional research income.

reviews.summary: CIHR resource inventory is acquisition/source metadata, not scientific payment rows.
reviews.mapConnection: No geographic observation; use source URLs to reach C054 annual payment originals.
needs: Scientific values and paid-institution identity come from the listed annual originals; sanitize local paths.
cannot: Cannot chart resource/file counts as research funding or infer activity from last-modified dates.

reviews.summary: NSERC resource inventory identifies award, partner, co-applicant and dictionary files.
reviews.mapConnection: No observation geography; exact institution mapping requires scientific award tables.
needs: Follow C046/C055 originals, validate award grain and period.
cannot: Cannot interpret source inventory counts as awards or payments.

reviews.summary: OpenAlex institution inventory provides query/identity context for indexed-work views, rather than a new independent outcome.
reviews.mapConnection: Reviewed OpenAlex IDs, display names and Canadian country codes join comparator institutions.
needs: Resolve ambiguous institution search candidates, preserve exact IDs and avoid raw local paths.
cannot: All-time works_count is not the bounded yearly view, verified publications, health-only output or a national unique-work total.

reviews.summary: Primary CFI workbook yields 185 observed decision-year rows and seven cumulative lead-institution summaries; all seven totals independently match upstream C008 comparator summaries.
reviews.mapConnection: All seven source institutions have reviewed representative campus points. McMaster’s official Hamilton main-campus address matches independently retrieved OpenStreetMap way 23122301.
needs: Historical institution names and collaborators need explicit identity/allocation rules for wider coverage.
cannot: CFI contribution is not annual cash paid, total project cost or CAUBO income. Project records lack a stable project ID. Medical, health and life sciences includes life sciences. No campus/population allocation.

reviews.summary: Full funding-decisions CSV has Institution_Paid, CIHR_Contribution, CIHR_Equipment and Term_Years_Months, but no fiscal/date field. It is cumulative decision context for CIHR, not an annual extension.
reviews.mapConnection: Exact paid-institution identity can join the campus registry after decisions scope reconciliation.
needs: Establish decision window and contribution/equipment semantics, reconcile C009 and annual C054 without adding unlike measures. Decode source Latin-1 consistently.
cannot: No annual payment trend, yearly growth or grants-paid total can be recovered from a table without a fiscal period. Personal Name field is excluded.

reviews.summary: Three non-director CRA T3010 originals were fully hash-verified and inspected: identification plus two financial forms. Directors table is catalogue-only and excluded.
reviews.mapConnection: Organization-level BN and FPE fiscal-end date require a reviewed legal-entity crosswalk, not name geocoding.
needs: Validate T3010 form-year dictionaries, numeric code semantics, BN identity and charity-versus-university scope; exclude directors/person fields.
cannot: Registered-charity totals are not research-only finance or campus allocations; directors cannot serve as map observations.

reviews.summary: Historical NSERC 1991–2000 award schemas and dictionary were inspected. They extend before the existing recent award window, while partner/co-applicant tables are supporting relationship metadata and remain unexposed.
reviews.mapConnection: Administering organization codes/names need dated exact institution identities for older award periods.
needs: Fully retrieve/hash-verify remaining multipart award sources, validate FiscalYear versus CompetitionYear, AwardAmount/Partie/Nb_Partie grain, duplicated 1999 exports and stable application keys.
cannot: Award amounts are not annual paid cash; partner/co-applicant rows do not create independent awards or funding. No researcher/person map.

reviews.summary: Verified Canadian institution identity and all-year indexed-work responses yield 70 observed rows for 2016–2025; all 35 overlapping 2021–2025 rows exactly reconcile with existing publications.
reviews.mapConnection: Seven verified institution IDs join the existing reviewed campus registry.
needs: Additional institutional/cancer-centre identities need exact source response and point review; distinguish work samples from full corpus.
cannot: No unique cross-institution total, health-only output or research impact inference; exclude partial 2026 and future-indexed 2027.

reviews.summary: Parent released 572 historical cancer incidence observations from the complete StatCan ZIP; remaining family contains hospital POIs, provincial graduate supply projections, historical DriveBC incidents and broad federal grant disclosures.
reviews.mapConnection: Exact original 2015 DGUID/HR_UID pairs join the official December 2015 Statistics Canada release for three Northern HSDAs. The BC benchmark stays unallocated in records and charts. Other tables retain separate gaps: hospital points need address/coordinate verification; graduate supply is provincial; incidents are source-coordinate events.
needs: inspect hospital location identity; province-only graduate chart needs rounded/projection labels; grant agreements require department/program filtering, amendment identity and complete multipart hash verification.
cannot: Projected graduate supply is not Northern staffing or UNBC output. Historical incidents are not live travel conditions. Broad grant agreements are not all research payments and cannot be added to agency funding.

reviews.summary: Seven original PubMed ESearch responses supply recorded affiliation-query counts, with 20-ID return samples each. Queries have differing exact names/abbreviations and no capture timestamp in response.
reviews.mapConnection: Recorded institution query context uses seven reviewed campus representatives; no article is allocated to a facility.
needs: Article-level affiliation validation, deduplication and recorded capture/year filters are needed for validated publication trends or cross-source coverage.
cannot: 20 returned IDs are samples, not total matches. Query counts are not verified institutional publications, annual output, impact or a PubMed/OpenAlex percentage.

reviews.summary: All collected annual CIHR workbooks 2000–2025 Q3 and dictionary were fully hash-verified; worksheet schemas inspected. Older books remain candidates; the Q3 expectation amount view is blocked by blank source values, supporting existing 2019–2024 payments. Archive is a duplicate delivery container.
reviews.mapConnection: InstitutionPaidCode/Name is the payment geography; ResearchInstitutionCode/Name is a separate role and must not silently replace it.
needs: Aggregate safe paid-institution fields by original FiscalYear and validate source funding-reference uniqueness per year. EN-Metadata row 28 states Q1–Q3 AmountPaidFY is EXPECTED full-fiscal-year payment subject to change, not actual money paid through Q3. Only Q4 is actual paid. All 7,309 expected-amount cells are blank (7,310 worksheet rows include the header), despite 7,309 unique paid institution/fiscal/reference keys. The seven exact comparator institutions contain 1,695 funding records, also with blank expected amounts. Future expected-payment adaptation must require actual nonempty amounts; older schemas need dictionary-based adapters.
cannot: Research teams/partners create no extra independent payments. Awarded/total paid amounts are not AmountPaidFY; Q3 expected amounts cannot be labeled paid-to-date or actual full-year payments. Blank expected cells cannot be zero, TotalAmountPaid (AB), TotalAmountAwarded (AC), or other inferred funding amounts; no extrapolation from Q3 or person/department map.

FiscalYear_AnneeFinanciere.notes: The Canadian government's fiscal year is from April 1st to March 31st. Fiscal year format: YYYYYY (e.g. 202324 for 2023-24).

InstitutionPaidCode_CodeEtablissementPay.definition: The institution paid’s four-letter institution code. The code is the institution's unique identifier.
InstitutionPaidCode_CodeEtablissementPay.notes: In cases where an award was paid directly to an individual or paid to an organization outside Canada that is unspecified, the code possibilities are one of “ZXXX, ZXXA, ZXXB.” In cases where the award was paid to an organization inside Canada that is unspecified, the Research Institution code is provided as the Institution Paid code as well.

AmountPaidFY_MontantPayeAF.definition:
Total amount paid for the grant or award in the current fiscal year. The amount is specific to a funding reference number (FRN) and the institution paid. In the event where a grant switches the institutions paid, the FRN and application information will appear on multiple rows for the same fiscal year. 

All CIHR funding and partner funding that is administered by CIHR is included. Partner funding that is administered independently from CIHR is excluded.
AmountPaidFY_MontantPayeAF.notes:
In the Q1-Q3 updates, this field will only report the expected amount to be paid in the current fiscal year. Expected amounts may be subject to change. In the Q4 (i.e. full fiscal year dataset) update, this field will provide the total amount paid during that fiscal year.

CIHR funding for new awards obtained through the Canada Research Chairs Program is included in the full fiscal year dataset only. 

Quarters correspond to:
Q1 (April 1-June 30)
Q2 (July 1-September 30)
Q3 (October 1-December 31)
Q4 (January 1-March 31)

TotalAmountPaid_MontantTotalPaye.definition:
Total amount paid for the grant or award up to the current fiscal year. The amount is specific to a funding reference number (FRN) and the institution paid. This is an expected value and may be subject to change. 

All CIHR funding and partner funding that is administered by CIHR is included. Partner funding that is administered independently from CIHR is excluded.
TotalAmountPaid_MontantTotalPaye.notes:
In the Q1-Q3 updates, this field will report the amount paid up to but not including the current fiscal year. In the Q4 (i.e. full fiscal year dataset) update, this field will include the amount paid from that fiscal year, and previous years.

CIHR funding for new awards obtained through the Canada Research Chairs Program is included in the full fiscal year dataset only. 

Quarters correspond to:
Q1 (April 1-June 30)
Q2 (July 1-September 30)
Q3 (October 1-December 31)
Q4 (January 1-March 31)

TotalAmountAwarded_MontantTotalAccorde.definition:
Total amount awarded for the grant or award overall. The amount is specific to a funding reference number (FRN) and the institution paid. This is an expected value and may be subject to change. 

All CIHR funding and partner funding that is administered by CIHR is included. Partner funding that is administered independently from CIHR is excluded.
TotalAmountAwarded_MontantTotalAccorde.notes:
CIHR funding for new awards obtained through the Canada Research Chairs Program is included in the full fiscal year dataset only. 

Quarters correspond to:
Q1 (April 1-June 30)
Q2 (July 1-September 30)
Q3 (October 1-December 31)
Q4 (January 1-March 31)

expectedAmountReview.reason: Every AmountPaidFY_MontantPayeAF source value is blank. The Q1–Q3 dictionary defines expected fiscal-year amounts, but this collected workbook contains none. TotalAmountPaid and TotalAmountAwarded are different measures and are not substituted; no amounts are converted to zero or inferred.
